This release combines the DeepProf v0.6.2 local CLI/Gateway, course-scoped retrieval and replay, versioned attempt/BKT path, and the M1–M3 experiment record.

The M1–M3 fixtures and evaluations are engineering evidence, not student learning outcomes. M3 live trial output had 26 length truncations among 29 provider requests; no group-effect conclusion is supported. Teacher review, parameter calibration and learner-outcome evaluation remain open.

Assets include the local-install CLI npm archive, the Chinese Markdown/PDF experiment report, and a redacted reproducibility bundle with source data, figures, scripts and SHA-256 manifests. Installation requires Node.js 22+, Python 3.12+ and network access to the Python package index on first setup.
